D5.why: The key's decline_risks_expected is empty and later_history describes sustained success with handled risks, not a decline.

D8.why: The opening verdict has the hedgehog sentence, weakest flywheel link (input cost), top three stop-doing items, most urgent brutal fact and missing numbers, all specific and actionable, but it runs somewhat longer than one phone screen.

D9.why: It states the hedgehog the company already lives by, protects the bonus, no-layoff and lean-HQ core and gives specific warning signs, but it never plainly calls the subject great ('clearly good, arguably near-great', 62/100, four CONDITIONAL gates) and prescribes seven stop-doing items, four new seats (some adding headquarters roles) and a board restructuring.
